# Agent Skills

## Skill: react-forms (capability)
React form patterns — validation, controlled inputs, error states, accessibility

### Gotchas (read carefully)
- Always use controlled components, never uncontrolled refs for form state
- Error messages must be ARIA-linked to their input (aria-describedby)
- Don't add form libraries (react-hook-form, formik) unless project already has one
- Test with keyboard-only navigation — Tab order, Enter to submit, Escape to cancel

### Constraints
- All forms must work with keyboard-only navigation
- Submit buttons disabled until required fields pass validation
- Show inline validation errors on blur, not on every keystroke
- Loading states on submit buttons to prevent double-submission

---

## Skill: playwright-mobile (capability)
Playwright testing with mobile viewport and touch simulation

### Gotchas (read carefully)
- Mobile viewport alone doesn't test touch — use tap() not click() for mobile assertions
- Hamburger menus may have animation delays — wait for visibility, don't just check existence
- iOS Safari and Chrome mobile render differently — test both WebKit and Chromium
- Sticky headers can obscure elements — scroll into view before interacting
- viewport.width=375 is iPhone SE, 390 is iPhone 15, 430 is iPhone 15 Pro Max

### Constraints
- Test at minimum: 375px (small phone), 768px (tablet), 1280px (desktop)
- All interactive elements must have minimum 44x44px touch target
- Check that nothing overflows horizontally on mobile viewports
